questions.question: Who amongst the following founded the Bharatiya Jana Sangh (BJS) in 1951?

questions.question: Fundamental duties were incorporated in the Indian Constitution by:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the __**42ⁿd Amendment**__.

__
 
• The **fundamental duties** were **incorporated** in the **Indian** **Constitution **by the **42ⁿd Constitutional Amendment **Act**, 1976**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **42nd Amendment** made fundamental changes in the constitutional structure.

 
 
• It incorporated the words '**Socialist**', '**Secular**', and '**Integrity**' in the Preamble.
 
• Fundamental duties were added in **Part** **IVA**.
 
• Directive Principles were given precedence over Fundamental Rights and any law made to this effect by the Parliament was kept beyond the scope of judicial review by the court.
 
• It authorized the **Supreme Court **to transfer certain cases from one **High **Court to another **High **Court and refined the **writ **jurisdiction of the High Courts.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **56th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1987**:

 
 
• Goa was made a full-fledged state with a State Assembly but Daman and Diu stayed as Union Territory.
 
 
 
• **25th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1971**:
 
 
• This Act came into force on **20th** **April 1972**.
 
• This Amendment restricted the jurisdiction of the Courts over acquisition laws with regard to the adequacy of Compensation.
 
• This amendment came primarily in the wake of the Bank Nationalisation case.
 
 
 
• **14th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1962**:
 
 
• Pondicherry, Karaikal, Mahe, and Yenam, the former French Territories, were specified in the Constitution as the Union Territory of Pondicherry (Now Puducherry).

questions.question: Which of the following soils is found in the northern plains of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Alluvial Soil__**.

__
 
• Alluvial soil is found in the Northern plains of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Alluvial soils are the most important and widespread category of soils.
 
 
• It covers approx **40 percent** of the land area.
 
• The entire Northern Plains are made of these soils.
 
• They have been brought down and deposited by three Himalayan rivers** Sutlej, Ganga, and the Brahmaputra**, and their tributaries.
 
• This soil is suitable for crops like** cereals, cotton, oilseeds, and sugarcane.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arid Soil:**

 
 
• This covers the entire area of the west Aravalis in Rajasthan and parts of Haryana, Punjab, and Gujrat.
 
 
• These soils are rich in phosphate and calcium but deficient in Nitrogen and humus.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Laterite Soil:**
 
 
• This soil formed due to the weathering of laterite rocks in high temperature and heavy rainfall with an alternate dry and wet period.
 
 
 
• **Black Soil:**
 
 
• These soils are of volcanic origin.
 
• This soil is ideal for growing cotton.

questions.question: The Right to Property was deleted from the list of Fundamental Rights by which of the Amendment of Indian Constitution?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**44th Amendment**__.

__
 
• The Right to Property was deleted from the list of Fundamental Rights by the 44th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1978**.**

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• 44th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1978 came into effect from **June- September 1979**.

 
 
• This Amendment was brought by the **Janata Party Government**.
 
• This Amendment repealed some of the changes effected by the 42ⁿd Amendment, omitted a few, and provided alterations.
 
• Right to property was taken away from the list of Fundamental Rights and placed in a new **Art**. **300A **as an ordinary legal right.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** 41st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976:**

 
 
• This Amendment Act is formally known as The Constitution Act, 1976.
 
• This Act changed the age of retirement of the Chairman and members of the State Public Service Commission from 60 to 62 years.
 
 
 
• **42ⁿd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976:**
 
 
• This Act made fundamental changes in the constitutional structure.
 
• It incorporated the words 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' in the Preamble.
 
• Fundamental duties were added in Part IVA.
 
• Directive Principles were given precedence over Fundamental Rights and any law made to this effect by the Parliament was kept beyond the scope of judicial review by the court.
 
 
 
• **43rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1977:**
 
 
• This Act omitted many articles inserted by the 42ⁿd Amendment Act.
 
• It restored the Jurisdiction of the Supreme Court and High Courts, which had been curtailed under the 42ⁿd Amendment Act.
